descriptions.en: [PH] Main bounty for MITW invasion
descriptions.zh: [PH] Main bounty for MITW invasion

descriptions.en: A Grineer leader will only show their face if we disrupt Grineer operations across several fronts.
descriptions.zh: 一名克隆尼领导者只会在我们干扰其多处前线行动的时候现身。

descriptions.en: A new Grineer commander has been no end of trouble. Capture them.
descriptions.zh: 一名新任的克隆尼指挥官已经不断在制造麻烦。捉住指挥官。

names.zh: 捕获新任克隆尼指挥官

descriptions.en: Deal a blow to a Grineer detachment's morale by capturing their commander.
descriptions.zh: 捉住他们的指挥官能对克隆尼的分遣队造成士气上的打击。

descriptions.en: The Grineer grow too strong in number. Weaken them.
descriptions.zh: 克隆尼的数量已经太多了。削弱他们。

descriptions.en: Expel the Grineer from their outpost on the Plains
descriptions.zh: 将克隆尼从他们在平野上的外哨赶出去

descriptions.en: Sever the Grineer supply chain.
descriptions.zh: 重创克隆尼的补给链。

descriptions.en: A high-ranking Grineer has landed on the plains. Bring them to the Lotus.
descriptions.zh: 一名高阶的克隆尼已经登陆到平野上。将他们带给莲。

descriptions.en: There's a Grineer spy in Cetus. Put pressure on the Grineer and force the spy out.
descriptions.zh: 发现一名克隆尼的间谍潜藏在希图斯村中。对克隆尼施加压力将那位间谍逼出来。

descriptions.en: Hunt down a Ghoul Alpha and weaken their presence on the plains.
descriptions.zh: 猎杀一个尸鬼头领，并削弱它们在平野上的规模。

descriptions.en: Launch an assault on Grineer burial grounds and send a message to Vay Hek.
descriptions.zh: 对克隆尼的埋养地发起进攻，向韦·海克表明立场。

descriptions.en: Find and destroy a Ghoul burial site before they can wake.
descriptions.zh: 在尸鬼觉醒前，找到并消灭尸鬼埋养地

names.en: PURGE A MASSIVE GHOUL BURIAL SITE
names.zh: 净化一个巨型尸鬼埋养地

descriptions.en: Steel Meridian has identified a potential Ghoul defector, rescue them from certain death.
descriptions.zh: 钢铁防线已经辨识出一个可能的尸鬼叛逃者，进行营救，避免其注定的死亡。

descriptions.en: Steal Vay Hek's Thrax Toxin, mix it, and poison the Infested Boil growing in the center of the plains.
descriptions.zh: 偷取韦·海克的瑟拉斯毒素，混合，并将毒素送去在平野中部生长的感染疖瘤。

descriptions.en: Steal Vay Hek's Thrax Toxin, mix it, and poison the Infested Boil growing in the center of the plains. An Eidolon Phylaxis and an Infested Catalyst is required.
descriptions.zh: 偷取韦·海克的瑟拉斯毒素，混合，并将毒素送去在平野中部生长的感染疖瘤。需要夜灵抗体和异变催化剂。

descriptions.en: Steal Vay Hek's Thrax Toxin, mix it, and poison the Infested Boil growing in the center of the plains. An Eidolon Phylaxis and an Infested Catalyst is required.
descriptions.zh: 偷取韦·海克的瑟拉斯毒素，混合，并将毒素送去在平野中部生长的感染疖瘤。需要夜灵抗体和异变催化剂。

descriptions.en: Find Onkko
descriptions.zh: 找到昂克

descriptions.en: Locate the Shatter-Lock pieces
descriptions.zh: 定位碎裂-锁定部件

descriptions.en: Locate the final fragment
descriptions.zh: 定位最后的碎片

descriptions.en: Team up with your fellow Tenno to take down three massive Eidolons.
descriptions.zh: 与你的天诺战友一起击倒三只巨型夜灵。

descriptions.en: Team up with your fellow Tenno to hunt a Teralyst.
descriptions.zh: 与你的天诺战友一起猎杀一只兆力使。

descriptions.en: Narmer are all fired up. They just promoted a cultist to Commander rank. Go and demote him to dead.
descriptions.zh: 合一众已被激怒。他们刚刚将一名信徒晋升为了指挥官。去把他降职至地狱。

descriptions.en: Narmer numbers are rising. They're planning something big. Cut them down before they march on Cetus again.
descriptions.zh: 合一众的人数正在增加。他们在谋划一件大事。在他们再次向希图斯进军之前解决他们。

descriptions.en: Narmer are recruiting by force. They've taken one of our own and are planning a veiling ceremony. Stop them.
descriptions.zh: 合一众正在强制招募教众。我们的人被他们掳走了，并且他们正在计划进行仪式来强戴面障。阻止他们。

descriptions.en: Narmer are pushed to the limit. If we raid their resources, we can push them right off the Plains.
descriptions.zh: 合一众已经被逼到了绝境。如果我们能夺取他们的资源，就能把他们赶出平野。

descriptions.en: Prove your ability. Show Konzu what you're capable of!
descriptions.zh: 证明你的能力。让孔尊看看你的能耐！

descriptions.en: The Grineer have taken an Orokin artifact. Find where they have stashed it.
descriptions.zh: 克隆尼夺走了一件奥罗金神器。找出他们已埋藏的神器。

descriptions.en: An item of great importance to the Quills has been taken by the Grineer. Locate the agent who stole it and bring him in.
descriptions.zh: 一件对夜羽的重要道具已经被克隆尼夺取。找出夺走神器的特工并捉住他。

descriptions.en: The Quills say the Grineer have stolen a precious Orokin artifact. Steal it back.
descriptions.zh: 夜羽表示克隆尼偷走了一件珍贵的奥罗金神器。把它偷回来。

descriptions.en: An Ostron has gone missing on the plains. Find them and bring them home.
descriptions.zh: 一名奥斯唐人在平野上失踪了。找到他们并带他们回家。

descriptions.en: Prototype tech is being delivered to the Grineer. Scour the Plains until you find it!
descriptions.zh: 原型科技正要运送给克隆尼。扫遍整个平野直到你找到为止！

descriptions.en: We are trying to regain a foothold out in Deimos. There are old bases lost to the Infestation that we need to reclaim.
descriptions.zh: 我们正试图重夺火卫二上的据点。我们需要夺回一些被感染者占据的旧基地。

descriptions.en: A powerful Infested entity has been terrorizing teams out in Deimos. Find it, and deal with it.
descriptions.zh: 一个强大的感染者生物吓到了火卫二上的队伍。找到它，并消灭它。

descriptions.en: Help a stranded Corpus agent with his mission to bring Infested samples to the Entrati for science!...or Profit?
descriptions.zh: 帮助一个受困的科普斯特工完成他的任务，也就是将感染者样本带给英择谛来进行科研！……或是用来盈利？

descriptions.en:
The Infested can't be endless, can they? They must stop returning after we kill enough... right?

Each stage of an Endless Bounty awards +15% Extra <MOTHER_TOKEN> Mother Tokens for every round completed.
descriptions.zh:
感染者的数量不可能是无穷无尽的，对吗？如果我们杀得足够多的话后面就没有了……对吗？

在完成无尽赏金任务的一个回合以后，下回合中的每个阶段都会奖励 +15% 额外数量的<MOTHER_TOKEN>"母亲"石印。

descriptions.en:
There are resources for the taking just beneath 'skin' of the Infestation covering Deimos. Dig for victory!

Each stage of an Endless Bounty awards +15% Extra <MOTHER_TOKEN> Mother Tokens for every round completed.
descriptions.zh:
覆盖火卫二的感染者"表皮"之下有着任君取用的资源。挖掘就是胜利！

在完成无尽赏金任务的一个回合以后，下回合中的每个阶段都会奖励 +15% 额外数量的<MOTHER_TOKEN>"母亲"石印。

descriptions.en:
Deimos artifacts are always in demand. Bring back as many as you can!

Each stage of an Endless Bounty awards +15% Extra <MOTHER_TOKEN> Mother Tokens for every round completed.
descriptions.zh:
火卫二的古物总是供不应求。能带回来多少就带回来多少！

在完成无尽赏金任务的一个回合以后，下回合中的每个阶段都会奖励 +15% 额外数量的<MOTHER_TOKEN>"母亲"石印。

descriptions.en: Search Deimos for valuable geological core samples.
descriptions.zh: 探索火卫二来获取有价值的地质核心样本。

descriptions.en: A squad of Grineer soldiers stranded on Deimos have activated their SOS beacon. Track them down and see what you can do to help.
descriptions.zh: 一队被困在火卫二上的克隆尼士兵启动了他们的求救信标。追踪他们，来看看你能提供什么帮助。

descriptions.en: Many resource caches lie abandoned and unclaimed on Deimos, find them and they are yours.
descriptions.zh: 许多资源储藏箱遗落在火卫二并且无人问津，找到它们，它们就是你的。

descriptions.en: Hunt down anomalous samples in the Deimos biome.
descriptions.zh: 在火卫二生物群落区寻找异常样本。

descriptions.en: Mother believes Father alone can repair the failing Heart. He must be found.
descriptions.zh: "母亲"认为只有"父亲"才能修复衰败的"心"。必须找到他。

names.en: LOCATE FATHER WITHIN THE CAMBION DRIFT
names.zh: 在魔胎之境中找到"父亲"

descriptions.en: Daughter is in charge of securing nutrition for the family. Help with her foraging expedition.
descriptions.zh: 女儿负责保障一家人的营养健康。帮助她完成觅食探险。

descriptions.en: The Infested are destroying the Entrati heritage. Clear them out before they do more harm
descriptions.zh: 感染者正在摧毁英择谛的遗产。在它们造成更多破坏之前把他们干掉。

descriptions.en: Odd fissures are appearing in the Deimos underground. Go back into the ruins. Find and close these anomalies
descriptions.zh: 火卫二地下出现了奇怪的裂缝。回到废墟中，找到并封闭这些异常点。

descriptions.en: As if the Infested in the Ruins weren't enough. Now all manner of disgusting... things are growing down there. It's time we cleaned house!
descriptions.zh: 好像废墟里的感染者还不够多似的。现在各种恶心的…… 东西在下面越来越多。是时候该来一次大扫除了！

descriptions.en: The Infested we are encountering around the old Vaults seem... different. Delve into the ruins and engage with infested so we may conduct research
descriptions.zh: 我们在旧隔离库周围遇到的感染者似乎…… 不太一样。潜入废墟，与感染者交战，这样我们就可以进行研究。

descriptions.en:
Explore an Isolation Vault.
While in the Cambion Drift:
Clear 1 Vault to access new Bounties.
Clear 3 Vaults for the rarest rewards!
descriptions.zh:
探索一个隔离库。
当身处魔胎之境中时：
清理 1 个隔离库来解锁新的赏金任务。
清理 3 个隔离库来获得最稀有的奖励！

descriptions.en:
Explore an Isolation Vault.
While in the Cambion Drift:
Clear 1 Vault to access new Bounties.
Clear 3 Vaults for the rarest rewards!
descriptions.zh:
探索一个隔离库。
当身处魔胎之境中时：
清理 1 个隔离库来解锁新的赏金任务。
清理 3 个隔离库来获得最稀有的奖励！

descriptions.en: Nef Anyo's captured some poor critters from the Vallis and stuffed 'em in his lab. Break 'em free.
descriptions.zh: 奈富·安尤从山谷捕获了一些可怜的小动物，并把它们塞进了实验室。把它们解救出来吧。

descriptions.en: Got a Corporate manager causing all sorts of trouble from their forward base. Take 'em out.
descriptions.zh: 有个企业经理在前线基地造成不少麻烦。快把他们解决掉。

descriptions.en: Nef Anyo's captured some poor critters from the Vallis and stuffed 'em in his lab. Break 'em free.
descriptions.zh: 奈富·安尤从山谷捕获了一些可怜的小动物，并把它们塞进了实验室。把它们解救出来吧。

descriptions.en: Got too many merk-merks mucking up the garden in their Nutrient Processing center. Go deal with 'em.
descriptions.zh: 花园里的营养加工中心被一堆雇佣兵弄得一团糟。去处理掉他们。

descriptions.en: Nef Anyo's captured some poor critters from the Vallis and stuffed 'em in his lab. Break 'em free.
descriptions.zh: 奈富·安尤从山谷捕获了一些可怜的小动物，并把它们塞进了实验室。把它们解救出来吧。

descriptions.en: Got a Corporate manager causing all sorts of trouble from their forward base. Take 'em out.
descriptions.zh: 有个企业经理在前线基地造成不少麻烦。快把他们解决掉。

descriptions.en: Nef Anyo's captured some poor critters from the Vallis and stuffed 'em in his lab. Break 'em free.
descriptions.zh: 奈富·安尤从山谷捕获了一些可怜的小动物，并把它们塞进了实验室。把它们解救出来吧。

descriptions.en: Got too many merk-merks mucking up the garden in their Nutrient Processing center. Go deal with 'em.
descriptions.zh: 花园里的营养加工中心被一堆雇佣兵弄得一团糟。去处理掉他们。

descriptions.en: Prepare to fight Exploiter by condensing diluted thermia using the machine in Deck 12.
descriptions.zh: 准备使用在甲板 12 号里的机械制造稀释的热美亚来挑战剥削者。

descriptions.en: The show-down.
descriptions.zh: 最终对决

descriptions.en: Acquire the satellite protocols.
descriptions.zh: 取得卫星协议

descriptions.en: Steal a Gravimag.
descriptions.zh: 窃取一个重力磁抵器

descriptions.en: Acquire the Profit-Taker's harmonic schema
descriptions.zh: 取得利润收割者的谐波架构

descriptions.en: A new Narmer Raknoid overseer is in place, acting as a veil comms relay. Take it out, and we weaken their grip.
descriptions.zh: 一个全新的合一众蛛形机监工已经就位，并负责面障的通信传输。摧毁它，我们就能削弱他们的控制。

descriptions.en: Narmer are on a recruitment drive. If we don't kick back hard, they'll entrench.
descriptions.zh: 合一众正在大规模地进行招募行动。如果我们不能狠厉出击，那他们就会借此再度站稳脚跟。

descriptions.en: There's a new Narmer operations drone on the field. We get that thing's datamass, we learn their next move.
descriptions.zh: 战场上出现了一架全新的合一众行动无人机。如果我们能得到它的数据块，就能知道合一众接下来的作战计划。

descriptions.en: Narmer cultists have staked out a mineral field so they can manufacture Veils. We need to stop them.
descriptions.zh: 合一众已经将一处矿区划为他们的地盘，以便制造面障。我们必须阻止他们。

descriptions.en: The Taxmen uncovered an Orokin artifact. Intercept the courier and steal it.
descriptions.zh: 税务官发现了一个奥罗金器物。拦截信使并夺走器物。

descriptions.en: Locate and retrieve relics from a dig site before Nef's goons can.
descriptions.zh: 在奈富的暴徒走狗们得逞前找到并取回一处挖掘地的遗物。

descriptions.en: Offworld rail agents are jumping Nef's claim on an Orokin ruin. Save them from themselves.
descriptions.zh: 异世的航道特工正在夺取奈富在奥罗金残迹的占地权。协助他们解救自己的命运。

descriptions.en: Draw out a notorious Corpus Overseer by targeting his assets. Then kill him.
descriptions.zh: 锁定他的资产来引诱出这位恶名昭彰的科普斯监工。然后干掉他。

descriptions.en: We gotta hijack some extractors. While they're prepped and launched Eudico has other work for you.
descriptions.zh: 我们要劫持一些采集机。在他们整备并发射时，尤迪科有些工作要你执行。

descriptions.en: Destroy a worker-control network, then kill its Overseer.
descriptions.zh: 摧毁一个工人控制网络，然后干掉监工。

descriptions.en: The Corpus are running training exercises for their troops. Wreak havoc.
descriptions.zh: 引开科普斯的安保，然后掠夺他们储备的矿物堆。

descriptions.en: Draw off Corpus security, then raid their mineral stockpile.
descriptions.zh: 引开科普斯的安保，然后掠夺他们储备的矿物堆。

descriptions.en: The Ventkids need parts to make K-Drives. Help 'em out?
descriptions.zh: 通风小子们需要组件来制作 K 式悬浮板。帮帮他们吧？

descriptions.en: Blackmail a Corpus investigator. Keep him away from our people.
descriptions.zh: 胁迫一名科普斯的调查员。让他远离我们的人民。

descriptions.en: A rail agent is waiting in orbit with a tractor full of supplies. He needs a landing permit. Forge one.
descriptions.zh: 一名航道特工正等候一艘在行星轨道上且满载补给的船舰。他需要登陆的许可证。帮他伪造一个来。

descriptions.en: A team shadowing Nef's special operations unit went silent. Find them and discover what they learned.
descriptions.zh: 一支盯梢奈富特种作战部队的小队与我们失去了联络。找到他们并取回他们探查到的情报。

descriptions.en: Word is the Corpus are prepping for multiple operations. We need info on what those operations entail.
descriptions.zh: 据说科普斯正在筹备多项行动。我们需要了解那些行动的进一步动向。

descriptions.en: Locate and erase key debt ledgers before Nef's repo squads can sweep through a targeted hab.
descriptions.zh: 在奈富的索回小组进攻目标通道之前找出并清除关键的债务分类帐册。

descriptions.en: Patrol the Vallis. Report back on anything unusual.
descriptions.zh: 巡逻山谷。回报任何异常情况。

descriptions.en: Free Solaris citizens snatched by Nef's interrogation units.
descriptions.zh: 释放被奈富审讯单位抓走的索拉里斯人民。

descriptions.en: Cut supply to the Corpus Feed and Research Division.
descriptions.zh: 减少对科普斯补给和研究部门的供应。

descriptions.en: An SU agent is missing. Discover their fate and put a stop to Nef's plans.
descriptions.zh: 一名索联的特工失踪了。揭露他们的命运并阻止奈富的计划。

descriptions.en: Coildrives assigned to picket duty upload data regularly. Hack one to upload a spy virus.
descriptions.zh: 线圈滚轮分配到巡逻哨定期上传资料。入侵一台来上传间谍病毒。

descriptions.en: Taxmen excavators have ID'd a motherlode. We need those minerals. Jump that claim.
descriptions.zh: 税务官们的挖掘机已经发现一条主矿脉。我们需要那些矿产。去占为己有吧。

descriptions.en: Steal back our taxes.
descriptions.zh: 偷回我们的税。

descriptions.en: Hunt down and kill a notorious Corpus war criminal.
descriptions.zh: 追击并消灭臭名昭著的科普斯战争罪犯。

descriptions.en: Destroy the shuttle of a high-value Corpus target.
descriptions.zh: 摧毁载有高价值科普斯目标的穿梭艇。
